functions.summary: Loads git history from a repository path when valid.

functions.name: main
functions.summary: Coordinates app setup, input collection, parsing, filtering, and tab rendering.

Stops early with user-friendly messages for empty/invalid inputs

patterns: Normalization boundary between raw JSON and analytics

functions.name: discover_available_phases

params.description: Phase folder names selected by user.

functions.returns: Flat list of JSON file paths.
implementationNotes: Skips missing phase folders without raising

functions.name: _infer_phase_name
functions.summary: Infers phase label from source path segments.

params.name: source_path
params.description: File path or upload source name.

implementationNotes: Normalizes path separators before extraction

functions.summary: Extracts probable username from path-like metadata in request variables.

params.name: requests
params.description: Raw request records from export file.

functions.name: _extract_referenced_files
functions.summary: Collects basename-only referenced file names from request variable metadata.

functions.name: _extract_code_metadata

functions.summary: Parses uploaded/on-disk chat exports into normalized request-level rows.

params.description: Mixed list of file paths and Streamlit UploadedFile objects.

functions.returns: Normalized dataframe for downstream tabs and analytics.
sideEffects: Emits Streamlit parse errors per file
implementationNotes: Skips malformed requests while preserving valid rows
Strips thinking blocks from assistant content concatenation
Computes derived metadata like checkpoint restore heuristic

functions.name: parse_git_history
functions.summary: Parses commit metadata for timeline and volume comparisons.

sideEffects: Emits Streamlit error if parsing fails

functions.name: calculate_success_metrics
functions.summary: Computes code-response count and heuristic flagged-revert count.

params.name: df
params.description: Chat dataframe with session ordering fields.

functions.name: analyze_prompt_style
functions.summary: Classifies prompt descriptors and computes complexity/length metadata.
functions.returns: Prompt-level dataframe for style and comparative visualizations.
implementationNotes: Descriptor extraction uses transparent keyword heuristics
Outputs boolean flags for chart-friendly aggregation

functions.name: safe_mean
functions.summary: Returns mean for non-empty series and 0.0 otherwise.
implementationNotes: Prevents NaN-heavy metric cards

functions.name: safe_rate
functions.summary: Returns boolean-column percentage rate with empty guard.
implementationNotes: Used heavily in phase comparison normalization

functions.name: phase_duration_days
functions.summary: Computes elapsed phase duration in days.
implementationNotes: Uses min/max timestamp boundaries

functions.name: tokens_per_prompt
functions.summary: Computes average prompt+completion tokens per interaction.
implementationNotes: Returns 0.0 for empty input

functions.name: error_rate_percent
functions.summary: Converts flagged revert ratio into normalized percentage.
implementationNotes: Delegates baseline counts to calculate_success_metrics

functions.name: avg_interactions_per_day
functions.summary: Computes phase interaction density by normalized day span.
functions.returns: Interactions per day (minimum denominator of 1 day).
implementationNotes: Avoids division by values under 1 day

functions.name: top_model_share_percent
functions.summary: Returns dominant model usage share and model name.

params.name: df_phase_chat
params.description: Phase-scoped chat rows with model column.
